spans.s:
.30 kaṇṭhaḥ कण्ठः
Anterior portion of the neck
A term which also denotes the larynx.

ITA-5.63.50 kaṇṭhagatarogaḥ कण्ठगतरोगः
Disorders of throat

ITA-5.63.58 kaṇṭhaśālūkaḥ कण्ठशालूकः
Adenoids
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a nodular swelling of kola size; sensation in throat resembling thorn pricks; throat filled with barley awn; rough and fixed nodular swelling; stable/immobile swelling; excisable swelling/swelling can be treated by surgery only; kola-shaped swelling; raised swelling.

ITA-5.63.38 galaśuṇḍikā (kaṇṭhaśuṇḍī) गलशुण्डिका (कण्ठशुण्डी)
Uvulitis or elongated uvula
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: rapid onset of a swelling in kākala; large swelling about the size of distended bladder; elongated swelling about the size of distended bladder; large oedema at the base of soft palate; elongated oedema at the base of soft palate; thirst; cough; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing; fish- or bladder-shaped oedema at the base of soft palate; soft oedema; elongated swelling; slimy swelling; expulsion of ingested food through nose; choking sensation of throat/ obstruction of throat; vomiting.

ITA-3.14.12 kaṇṭhasirā कण्ठसिरा
Vessels of the neck

.31 kaṇṭhyam कण्ठ्यम्
Substance promoting health and functioning of the throat

kaṇḍarā कण्डरा
Tendon
Supportive structural component of blood

.69 kaṇḍūghnaḥ, kaṇḍūharaḥ, kaṇḍūpraśamanaḥ कण्डूघ्नः, कण्डुहरः, कण्डू प्रशमनः
Anti-pruritic

kāṇḍam काण्डम्
Diaphysis
Shaft or central portion of a long bone.
